body:
The original software Kerr frame remains over300seconds. This is a distinct private provider-compiler candidate; no speedup or adoption is established.

Mesa25.2.8 `lp_state_cs.c:generate_compute` selects LLVM coroutines whenever `nir->info.uses_control_barrier` is set. `lp_bld_nir_soa.c:visit_barrier` suspends for every non-NONE execution scope. A shader subgroup-barrier substitution therefore does not remove the machinery, and deleting application execution barriers is not justified.

The existing normal-sum Transport/Endpoint/Dopri modules have static16x1x1 workgroups. The host supports AVX512, while Mesa's default CPU vector policy is capped at256bits/eight lanes. A guarded provider path can evaluate one complete16-invocation workgroup as one logical LLVM vector, preserve every original memory fence and shared/global access, and satisfy its execution rendezvous without coroutine scheduling between vectors. Sirius's 35 shaders, tables, interfaces, arithmetic, all40fields/fourcolumns/sevenRHS/threetrials/fourquartics, source and scenes remain unchanged.

Implement only in a private provider source/build inside this checkout, preserving original sources/providers. Require constant16x1x1 compute workgroups, supported512-bit CPU vector capability, and no subgroup-sensitive operation/system value; unsupported/general/dynamic/mesh workgroups retain the original lowering. Transform a private NIR clone so other variants cannot inherit removed control scope. Memory scopes/semantics remain original, and the provider—not application assumptions—owns the execution guarantee.

Finite acceptance: review the complete eligibility/control-flow/memory/frame contracts; bind authentic source and matched baseline/candidate provider builds using existing tools, with no global installation or capability/property fabrication. Inspect ordinary executed LLVM code and actual width/shared-memory behavior before benefit. Exercise cross-lane memory/atomic joins and the original arithmetic/provider/eight controls, retaining all original independent expectations, refusals/recovery/rollback. Require the original fixedABBA once, threerepeats/slot, allfour whole-call>=5%,16 inclusive stage>=-5%, both provisioning-inclusive API>=0%; no pooling/subtraction, weakened settings, retries or adoption on static/JIT facts. Reject on any required failure. Only a surviving integrated candidate justifies the original cold frame.

This does not close #44/#48/#53, full Mandatory/scientific/provider/native/physical/viewer or final-main installed-release qualification. PR62 stays draft at6d2af336; main stays5e706073.
